description: Defines the 'Stream' class implementing PSR HTTP StreamInterface within the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, providing methods for stream management such as reading, writing, seeking, and metadata retrieval. It handles resource validation and stream lifecycle operations.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Implementation of PSR-7 StreamInterface for managing streams with methods for reading, writing, seeking, and metadata operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Stream object with a resource or string stream and mode.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns stream contents as string if readable, rewinding if seekable.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new resource to the stream object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the pointer to a specified position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads remaining content from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or specific meta info by key.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the internal stream resource, handling string or resource input.

methods.name: isValidStreamResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource is of a permitted type for stream operations.
